result.summary: Found 1 major issue: an untranslated or placeholder text string is visible in the UI where a section title should be displayed.

issues.description: The section header displays 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of an actual translated title. This appears to be a developer/translation key that was not properly localized before being displayed to users.
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder text with the appropriate translated section title (e.g., 'Popular', 'Popular near you', 'Most ordered', etc.) depending on the intended meaning for this section.
